problem: The exact-source Netlify fallback upload returned 401 Unauthorized even though OIDC proxy acquisition had succeeded earlier in the same production snapshot job.
root_cause: The short-lived Netlify MCP proxy was acquired before the linked-build attempt and reused after provider polling and fallback preparation. By the time npx @netlify/mcp executed, the earlier proxy could be stale.
prevention: Refresh the OIDC-backed Netlify MCP proxy immediately before every exact-source fallback upload.
Do not reuse a proxy across a potentially long linked-build/provider-watch phase.
Keep exact-main commit_ref proof and browser NL/EN readback as terminal gates.
Classify 401 from fallback transport separately from site build failures.

evaluation.expected_invariant: a fresh OIDC-backed Netlify MCP proxy is acquired immediately before exact-source fallback upload
